specGapAdvisories38a.gapSummary: The spec defines task/session timeout handling and watchdog terminal-state treatment, but does not define ACP sessions.json index reconciliation, zombie session close markers, polling cadence, grace-period rules, or closure reasons.
specGapAdvisories38a.recommendedSpecPatch: Add an FR/AC under runtime watchdog/session lifecycle defining ACP session-index reconciliation: which session indexes are scanned, how Task/Board childSessionKey maps to ACP sessions, exact conditions for setting closed=true, stale and grace thresholds, fields written, event/audit/log requirements, and safeguards preventing active running sessions from being closed.
specGapAdvisories38a.reason: This is not a pure bugfix against an already specified behavior because the supplied ACO spec does not define the ACP sessions.json index as a product data entity or the user-visible semantics for auto-closing zombie ACP sessions, even though timeout/watchdog concepts are partially covered.
